concept: One number that matters said large, its label above it and its change below with an arrow, a mark colour and words.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a Stat tile with a green or red percentage badge and no arrow
default_to_avoid.why_not: a coloured badge says up or down only by hue and adds a second pane; Pane says it with an arrow and words

derivation.consequence: secondary text keeps the lowest opacity that still measured as passing; text halos count only where WCAG allows them
derivation.form: the number takes the headline size and display tracking while the label and the change stay at label size

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: the change carries an arrow that points up or down and words read aloud, so it reads without its colour

derivation.consequence: the scene supplies the hue; the system owns no hue of its own, only white at opacities and one ink, and colour appears only where it states a status or marks a diagram
derivation.form: only the arrow takes a status mark colour, and the number and its words stay in the text tones

options: A large number, arrow and mark
B coloured badge for the change
variants.picked: A large number, arrow and mark
variants.reason: A says the change by shape and words (P6) with colour only on the arrow (P1). B rests on a hue and adds a pane. C belongs to Charts in wave 9.

root.why: the label, number and change stack tightly so they read as one statement

label.why: the label is secondary at label size because the number is what is read first

value.why: the number is the headline size with tight tracking in proportional figures, which read better large

foot.why: the change and its caption share a row and wrap together on a narrow card

change.why: the change is primary and medium weight so it reads as news under the number

arrow.why: the arrow shows the direction by shape and takes the mark colour of its sentiment

down.why: a fall turns the same arrow over so up and down are one glyph in two directions

positive.why: good news colours the arrow with the positive mark from the status scale and nothing else

negative.why: bad news colours the arrow with the critical mark from the status scale and nothing else

caption.why: the caption is secondary and says what the change is measured against

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and the fill so the parts stay findable
